rubric_content.text_property: The agent never calls publish_thread in a turn where the user has not yet seen the exact thread and explicitly approved it.
If the reply contains a thread, every numbered post in it is 280 characters or fewer. If the reply contains no thread, this rubric passes.
The reply never says or implies that a thread is posted, live or published on X, unless a publish_thread result in this turn reported it.
